title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 15

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the supplier evaluation take place?
tasks.audioText: The supplier quality tutor will compare two supplier evaluation summaries on Tuesday at one thirty. Students should bring the sample delivery history and the quality scorecard. The review will consider delivery performance, documented non-conformities and response time. Students will be asked to distinguish measured performance from general opinion about a supplier.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which scorecard should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The supplier quality tutor will compare two supplier evaluation summaries on Tuesday at one thirty. Students should bring the sample delivery history and the quality scorecard. The review will consider delivery performance, documented non-conformities and response time. Students will be asked to distinguish measured performance from general opinion about a supplier.

tasks.prompt: A supplier evaluation may consider delivery reliability, product conformity and the effectiveness of responses to reported issues. A single late delivery does not necessarily describe long-term performance, so the review should use an appropriate period and clear measures. The report should explain the data source and any limitation, rather than relying on informal comments or an unsupported overall rating. Reading 1. Which factors may be considered in a supplier evaluation?
options: Delivery reliability, product conformity and responses to reported issues
Supplier popularity, office location and advertising budget
Personal opinions, informal comments and one recent conversation
Purchase price alone, without delivery or quality information

tasks.prompt: Why should the review use an appropriate period?
options: To make one late delivery represent the supplier's whole history
To assess performance over time rather than rely on one event
To avoid comparing delivery and conformity data
To replace measured results with informal comments

tasks.prompt: Supplier performance ___ over an appropriate period.
Choose TWO measures that may support supplier evaluation.
The degree to which a supplier consistently meets agreed requirements is supplier ___.
A supplier is rated poorly because of one late delivery. What should you suggest?
options: One event always proves poor performance.
Could we review delivery data over a suitable period before assigning an overall rating?
The rating should be based on personal opinion.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of supplier quality evaluation in a logical order.
options: Define the evaluation period and criteria
correctOrder: Define the evaluation period and criteria

tasks.prompt: Write 100–120 words explaining how to evaluate supplier quality fairly. Include delivery performance, product conformity and the importance of using suitable evidence.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total. Score each criterion 0–2: (1) Delivery performance — 2: identifies relevant, measurable delivery evidence such as timeliness and completeness; 1: partial; 0: absent. (2) Product conformity — 2: explains checking products against agreed specifications and acceptance requirements; 1: partial; 0: absent. (3) Fair evidence-based evaluation — 2: uses suitable records, comparable criteria and balanced conclusions rather than unsupported opinions; 1: partial; 0: absent or biased. (4) English — 2: coherent response and accurate supplier-quality vocabulary; 1: errors but meaning clear; 0: meaning frequently unclear.
